node: Delivery marketplace access, first-party ordering, loyalty, POS, and restaurant customer-data infrastructure
summary: Layer 1B expands the public-company universe around restaurant customer-access infrastructure. The reference lane is Toast, which is the clearest scaled restaurant operating-system anchor. The underfollowed lane is more interesting for this node: PAR Technology, NCR Voyix, and Lightspeed Commerce all sit in POS, payments, ordering, loyalty, kitchen/display, and restaurant workflow layers that help restaurants preserve first-party orders, guest data, and margin versus delivery marketplaces. Olo would normally be a core candidate, but current search evidence indicates a 2025 merger/change-of-control trail, so it is excluded pending confirmation of current public listing status.
